title: Home-Site Lease Renewal Pricing Rider: Home Loan Standing
content:
**Rider to Home-Site Lease renewal pricing — home loan standing**

A home-loan adjustment, in percentage points, is added to the renewal increase rate of a Home-Site Lease renewal offer. It reads the resident's Hearthstone home-only loan under Home Purchase Financing on the day the offer is issued: the loan's status and the late charges assessed on it in the trailing 12 calendar months.

**Clause.** A loan in active status with no late charge assessed in the trailing 12 calendar months gives -0.25 percentage points. A loan in delinquent status gives 0.25 percentage points. Any other case, including no Hearthstone loan, gives zero.

| Home Purchase Financing loan of the resident | Late charge assessed in the trailing 12 calendar months | Home-loan adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | -0.25 (rate 0.25 points lower) |
| active | one or more | zero |
| delinquent | any | 0.25 (rate 0.25 points higher) |
| any other status | any | zero |
| no Hearthstone loan | — | zero |

**Hypothetical applications** (renewal increase rate of 5.0 percent assumed for illustration)

- An active loan whose last late charge was assessed 15 months before the offer: no late charge in the window, so -0.25, giving 4.75 percent after this adjustment.
- An active loan with a late charge assessed four months before the offer: zero.
- A delinquent loan: 0.25, giving 5.25 percent after this adjustment.
- A resident who financed the home with another lender and holds no Hearthstone loan: zero.
